name: Moong dal chilla with coconut chutney
steps: Soak the moong dal for a couple of hours, then blend with water into a thick batter.
Stir the chopped onion and tomato through the batter.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot griddle, spread thin, and cook both sides until golden.
Blend the desiccated coconut with a little yoghurt and green chilli for the chutney, and serve alongside.

name: Kerala-style vegetable stew with brown rice
steps: Simmer the mixed vegetables in a little water until just tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and curry leaves, and warm through gently without boiling.
Serve the stew hot with the cooked brown rice.

name: Puttu with chickpea curry
steps: Layer the rice flour and desiccated coconut in a steamer and steam for 10 minutes.
Simmer the chickpeas with the onion and spices until soft for the curry.
Turn the puttu out onto a plate and serve with the chickpea curry.

name: Wholemeal vegetable dosa with tomato chutney
steps: Whisk the wholemeal flour and semolina with water into a thin batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot griddle and spread thin; cook until crisp at the edges.
Blend the tomatoes and onion with a little oil and mustard seeds for the chutney, and serve alongside.

name: Maharashtrian poha with peanuts and peas
steps: Rinse the poha briefly in a sieve until softened, then drain well.
Fry the onion and peas with mustard seeds and curry leaves until soft.
Add the poha and crushed peanuts, toss gently to warm through, and finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Oat upma with vegetables and peanuts
steps: Dry-roast the rolled oats until lightly toasted and set aside.
Fry the onion and mixed vegetables with mustard seeds and curry leaves until soft.
Stir in the oats and enough hot water, then cook covered until fluffy; finish with the crushed peanuts.

name: Thalipeeth with yoghurt
steps: Mix the besan and wholemeal flour with the onion and enough water to form a soft dough.
Pat the dough thin directly onto a hot griddle and cook both sides until golden.
Serve hot with the yoghurt on the side.

name: Rava vegetable upma with peanuts
steps: Dry-roast the semolina until lightly golden and set aside.
Fry the onion and mixed vegetables with mustard seeds and curry leaves until soft.
Stir in the semolina and enough hot water, then cook covered until fluffy; finish with the crushed peanuts.
